en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
cause my faith to reach the most perfect faith,
make my certainty the most excellent certainty,

ar: و انتَهِ بِنِيَّتِي إلَى أَحْسَنِ النِّيَّـاتِ،
en: and take my intention to the best of intentions
and my works to the best of works!
O God, complete my intention through Thy gentleness,
rectify my certainty through what is with Thee,
and set right what is corrupt in me through Thy power!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
spare me the concerns which distract me,
employ me in that about which Thou wilt ask me tomorrow,
and let me pass my days in that for which Thou hast created me!
Free me from need, expand Thy provision toward me,

ar: وَلاَ تَفْتِنِّي بِالبَطَرِ، وَأَعِزَّنِي، وَلا تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِالْكِبْرِ،
en: and tempt me not with ingratitude! Exalt me and afflict me not with pride!

ar: وَعَبِّدْنِي لَكَ وَلاَ تُفْسِدْ عِبَادَتِي بِالْعُجْبِ،
en: Make me worship Thee and corrupt not my worship with self-admiration!

ar: وَأَجْرِ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى يَدَيَّ الْخَيْرَ، وَلا تَمْحَقْهُ بِالْمَنِّ،
en: Let good flow out from my hands upon the people and efface it not by my making them feel obliged!

ar: وَهَبْ لِي مَعَالِيَ الأَخْلاَقِ، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الْفَخْرِ.
en: Give me the highest moral traits and preserve me from vainglory!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
raise me not a single degree before the people
without lowering me its like in myself
and bring about no outward exaltation for me

ar: إلاّ أَحْدَثْتَ لِي ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِنْدَ نَفْسِي بِقَدَرِهَا.
en: without an inward abasement in myself to the same measure!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
en: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

ar: وَمَتِّعْنِي بِهُدىً صَالِح لا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ،
en: give me to enjoy a sound guidance which I seek not to replace,
a path of truth from which I swerve not,
and an intention of right conduct in which I have no doubts!

ar: وَعَمِّرْنِي مَا كَانَ عُمْرِيْ بِذْلَةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
en: Let me live as long as my life is a free gift in obeying Thee,
but if my life should become a pasture for Satan,

ar: فَـاقْبِضْنِي إلَيْـكَ قَبْـلَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَ مَقْتُـكَ إلَيَّ،
en: seize me to Thyself before Thy hatred overtakes me
or Thy wrath against me becomes firm!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَدَعْ خَصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّي إلاّ أَصْلَحْتَهَا،
en: O God, deposit in me no quality for which I will be faulted, unless Thou settest it right,

ar: وَلا عَآئِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إلاّ حَسَّنْتَهَا،
en: no flaw for which I will be blamed, unless Thou makest it beautiful,

ar: وَلاَ أُكْرُومَـةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إلاّ أَتْمَمْتَهَا.
en: no deficient noble trait, unless Thou completest it!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
en: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household

ar: وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْ بِغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَئانِ الْمَحَبَّةَ
en: and replace for me the animosity of the people of hatred with love,
the envy of the people of insolence with affection,
the suspicion of the people of righteousness with trust,
the enmity of those close with friendship,
the disrespect of womb relatives with devotion,
the abandonment of relatives with help,
the attachment of flatterers with love set right,
the rejection of fellows with generous friendliness,

ar: وَمِنْ مَرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِينَ حَلاَوَةَ الأَمَنَةِ.
en: and the bitterness of the fear of wrongdoers with the sweetness of security!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ يَداً عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي
en: appoint for me a hand against him who wrongs me,
a tongue against him who disputes with me,
and a victory over him who stubbornly resists me!

ar: وَهَبْ لِي مَكْراً عَلَى مَنْ كَايَدَنِي
en: Give me guile against him who schemes against me,
power over him who oppresses me,
refutation of him who reviles me,
and safety from him who threatens me!
Grant me success to obey him who points me straight
and follow him who guides me right!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

ar: وَسَدِّدْنِي لاَِنْ أعَـارِضَ مَنْ غَشَّنِي بِالنُّصْـحِ،
en: and point me straight to resist him who is dishonest toward me with good counsel,

ar: وَأَجْـزِيَ مَنْ هَجَرَنِي بِالْبِرِّ وَأُثِيبَ مَنْ حَرَمَنِي بِالْبَذْلِ
en: repay him who separates from me with gentle devotion, reward him who deprives me with free giving,
recompense him who cuts me off with joining,

ar: وأُخَـالِفَ مَنِ اغْتَابَنِي إلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ،
en: oppose him who slanders me with excellent mention,

ar: وَأَنْ أَشْكرَ الْحَسَنَةَ وَاُغْضِيَ عَنِ السَّيِّئَـةِ.
en: give thanks for good, and shut my eyes to evil!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
adorn me with the adornment of the righteous,

ar: وَأَلْبِسْنِي زِينَةَ المُتَّقِينَ فِيْ بَسْطِ الْعَدْلِ
en: and clothe me in the ornaments of the godfearing, through spreading justice,

ar: وَكَظْمِ الْغَيْظِ وَإطْفَاءِ النَّائِرَةِ وَضَمِّ أَهْلِ الْفُرْقَةِ
en: restraining rage, quenching the flame of hate, bringing together the people of separation,
correcting discord, spreading about good behaviour,
covering faults, mildness of temper,
lowering the wing, beauty of conduct,
gravity of bearing, agreeableness in comportment,

ar: وَالسَّبْقِ إلَى الْفَضِيلَةِ، وإيْثَارِ التَّفَضُّلِ و تَركِ التَّعييرِ،
en: precedence in reaching excellence, preferring bounteousness, refraining from condemnation,

ar: وَالإفْضَالِ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْمُسْتَحِقِّ وَالـقَوْلِ بِالْحَقِّ وَإنْ عَـزَّ
en: bestowing bounty on the undeserving, speaking the truth, though it be painful,

ar: وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الخَيْـرِ وَإنْ كَثُـرَ مِنْ قَـوْلِي وَفِعْلِي ،
en: making little of the good in my words and deeds, though it be much,

ar: وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الشَّرِّ وَإنْ قَلَّ مِنْ قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي،
en: and making much of the evil in my words and deeds, though it be little!

ar: وَأكْمِلْ ذَلِكَ لِي بِدَوَامِ الطَّاعَةِ وَلُزُومِ الْجَمَاعَةِ
en: Perfect this for me through lasting obedience, holding fast to the community,

ar: وَرَفْضِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ وَمُسْتَعْمِلِ الرَّأي الْمُخْتَرَعِ.
en: and rejecting the people of innovation and those who act in accordance with original opinions!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إذَا كَبُرتُ ،
en: appoint for me Thy widest provision in my old age
and Thy strongest strength when I am exhausted,
try me not with laziness in worship of Thee,

ar: وَلا الْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ وَلاَ بِالتَّعَرُّضِ لِخِلاَفِ مَحَبَّتِكَ،
en: blindness toward Thy path, undertaking what opposes love for Thee,
joining with him who has separated himself from Thee,
and separating from him who has joined himself to Thee!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أصُوْلُ بِكَ عِنْدَ الضَّرُورَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ عِنْدَ الْحَاجَةِ،
en: O God, make me leap to Thee in times of distress, ask from Thee in needs,
and plead to Thee in misery!

ar: وَلا تَفْتِنّي بِالاسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ،
en: Tempt me not to seek help from other than Thee when I am distressed,

ar: وَلا بِالْخُضُوعِ لِسُؤالِ غَيْرِكَ إذَا افْتَقَـرْتُ ،
en: to humble myself in asking from someone else when I am poor,

ar: وَلاَ بِـالتَّضَـرُّعِ إلَى مَنْ دُونَـكَ إذَا رَهِبْتُ
en: or to plead with someone less than Thee when I fear,
for then I would deserve Thy abandonment,
Thy withholding, and Thy turning away, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِي رَوْعِي مِنَ التَّمَنِّي وَالتَّظَنِّي وَالْحَسَـدِ
en: O God, make the wishing, the doubt, and the envy which Satan throws into my heart
a remembrance of Thy mightiness,
a reflection upon Thy power,
and a devising against Thy enemy!

ar: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِي مِنْ لَفْظَةِ فُحْش أَوْ هُجْر
en: Make everything he causes to pass over my tongue, - the indecent or ugly words,

ar: أَوْ شَتْمِ عِرْض أَوْ شَهَادَةِ بَاطِل
en: the maligning of good repute, the false witness,

ar: أو اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِن غَائِبِ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِر،
en: the speaking ill of an absent man of faith or the reviling of one present,

ar: وَمَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ نُطْقاً بِالْحَمْدِ لَكَ
en: and all things similar - a speech in praise of Thee,
a pursual of eulogizing Thee,
an excursion in magnifying Thee,
a thanksgiving for Thy favour,
an acknowledgement of Thy beneficence,
and an enumeration of Thy kindnesses!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَلاَ اُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ مُطِيقٌ لِلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي،
en: let me not be wronged while Thou canst repel from me,

ar: وَلا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ القَادِرُ عَلَى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي،
en: let me not do wrong while Thou art powerful over holding me back,
let me not be misguided while Thou art able to guide me,
let me not be poor while with Thee is my plenty,
let me not be insolent while from Thee comes my wealth!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ إلَى مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَفَدْتُ، وَإلَى عَفْوِكَ قَصَـدْتُ،
en: O God, I come to Thy forgiveness, I go straight to Thy pardon,
I yearn for Thy forbearance, and I trust in Thy bounty,

ar: وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَا يُوجِبُ لِي مَغْفِرَتَكَ،
en: but there is nothing with me to make me warrant Thy forgiveness,

ar: وَلاَ فِي عَمَلِي مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ،
en: nothing in my works to make me merit Thy pardon,

ar: وَمَا لِي بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاَّ فَضْلُكَ،
en: and nothing on my behalf after I judge my soul but Thy bounty,
so bless Muhammad and his Household
and bestow Thy bounty upon me!
O God, make my speech be guidance,

ar: وَأَلْهِمْنِي ألتَّقْـوَى وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِيَ أَزْكَى
en: inspire me with reverential fear, give me success in that which is most pure,
and employ me in what is most pleasing to Thee!
O God, let me tread the most exemplary path
and make me live and die in Thy creed!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَمَتِّعْنِي بِالاقْتِصَادِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّدَادِ،
en: give me to enjoy moderation, make me into one of the people of right behaviour,

ar: وَمِنْ أَدِلَّةِ الرَّشَادِ، وَمِنْ صَالِحِي الْعِبَادِ،
en: the proofs of right conduct, and the servants of righteousness,
and provide me with triumph at the place of Return and safety from the Ambush!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ نَفْسِي مَـا يُخَلِّصُهَا،
en: O God, take to Thyself from my soul what will purify it

ar: وَأَبْق لِنَفْسِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَـا يُصْلِحُهَا;
en: and leave for my soul that of my soul that will set it right,
for my soul will perish unless Thou preservest it!
O God, Thou art my stores when I sorrow,
Thou art my recourse when I am deprived,
from Thee I seek aid when troubled

ar: وَعِنْدَكَ مِمَّا فَاتَ خَلَفٌ، وَلِمَا فَسَدَ صَلاَحٌ،
en: and with Thee is a substitute for everything gone by, a correction for everything corrupted,
and a change from everything Thou disapprovest.

ar: فَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ قَبْلَ الْبَلاءِ بِالْعَافِيَةِ، وَقَبْلَ الطَّلَبِ بِالْجِدةِ،
en: So show kindness to me with well-being before affliction, wealth before asking,

ar: وَقَبْلَ الضَّلاَلِ بِالرَّشَادِ، وَاكْفِنِي مَؤُونَةَ مَعَرَّةِ الْعِبَادِ،
en: right conduct before misguidance; suffice me against the burden of shame toward the servants,

ar: وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمْنَ يَوْمِ الْمَعَادِ، وَامْنَحنِي حُسْنَ الارْشَادِ.
en: give me security on the Day of Return, and grant me excellent right guidance!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
repel from me through Thy gentleness, feed me through Thy favour,
set me right through Thy generosity, heal me through Thy benefaction,
shade me in Thy shelter, wrap me in Thy good pleasure,

ar: وَوَفِّقنِي إذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الأمُـورُ لأِهْدَاهَـا،
en: and give me success to reach the most guided of affairs when affairs confuse me,
the purest of works when works seem similar,
and the most pleasing to Thee of creeds when creeds conflict!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
crown me with sufficiency, place in me excellent guardianship,

ar: وَهَبْ لِيْ صِدْقَ الْهِدَايَةِ، وَلا تَفْتِنِّي بِالسَّعَةِ،
en: give me to guide correctly, tempt me not with plenty,

ar: وَامْنَحْنِي حُسْنَ الدَّعَةِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْ عَيْشِي كَدّاً كَدّاً،
en: grant me excellent ease, make not my life toil and trouble,
and refuse not my supplication in rejection,

ar: فَإنِّي لا أَجْعَلُ لَكَ ضِدّاً وَلا أَدْعُو مَعَكَ نِدّاً.
en: for I make none rival to Thee and I supplicate none with Thee as equal!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَامْنَعْنِي مِنَ السَّرَفِ وَحَصِّنْ رِزْقِي مِنَ التَّلَفِ،
en: hold me back from prodigality, fortify my provision against ruin,
increase my possessions through blessing them,

ar: وَأَصِبْ بِي سَبِيلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيمَا اُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ.
en: and set me upon the path of guidance through piety in what I spend!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
spare me the burden of earning,
and provide for me without reckoning,
lest I be distracted from Thy worship through seeking
and carry the load of earning's ill results!
O God, bestow upon me what I seek through Thy power
and grant me sanctuary from what I fear through Thy might!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَصُنْ وَجْهِي بِالْيَسَارِ،
en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, save my face through ease,

ar: وَلاَ تَبْتَذِلْ جَاهِي بِالإقْتارِ فَأَسْتَرْزِقَ أَهْلَ رِزْقِكَ،
en: and demean not my dignity through neediness, lest I seek provision from those whom Thou hast provided

ar: وَأَسْتَعْطِيَ شِرَارَ خَلْقِكَ، فَأفْتَتِنَ بِحَمْدِ مَنْ أَعْطَانِي،
en: and asks for bestowal from the worst of Thy creatures! Then I would be tried by praising him who gave to me

ar: وَاُبْتَلَى بِـذَمِّ مَنْ مَنَعَنِي وَأَنْتَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الإعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ.
en: and afflicted with blaming him who held back from me, while Thou - not they - art patron of giving and holding back.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
and provide me with soundness in worship,
detachment in renunciation,

ar: وَعِلْماً فِي اسْتِعمَـال، وَوَرَعـاً فِي إجْمَال.
en: knowledge put into action, and abstinence in measure!
O God, seal my term with Thy pardon,
verify my expectation in hoping for Thy mercy,
smooth my paths to reach Thy good pleasure,
and make my works good in all my states!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
incite me to remember Thee in times of heedlessness,
employ me in Thy obedience in days of disregard,

ar: وَانْهَجْ لِي إلى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبيلاً سَهْلَةً
en: open a smooth road for me to Thy love,

ar: أكْمِلْ لِي بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِـرَةِ.
en: and complete for me thereby the good of this world and the next
O God, and bless Muhammad and his Household

ar: كَأَفْضَلِ مَـا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ،
en: the best Thou hast blessed any of Thy creatures before him
and wilt bless any of them after him,

ar: وَآتِنا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً ،
en: and "give to us in this World good, and in the next world good" (2:201),
and protect me through Thy mercy "from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!
